Name: Better Stardew Valley
Author: EddieF612
Description:
[size=5][b]Better Stardew Valley (BSV) 2.0 — Beta[/b][/size]

[i]English first. 中文介绍在下方。[/i]

BSV adds quality-of-life systems, automation and new content that stays close to the look and balance of vanilla Stardew Valley. Version 2.0 is a large update over 1.0.3. This is a [b]beta[/b]: please back up your save and report any problem with your SMAPI log.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer[/*]
[*]Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu (in-game settings)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[b]Water machines[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Automatic Fishing Machine[/b] — recipe unlocked at Fishing level 5. Place it on a bank (outdoors or in caves). It only catches fish that live in that water at that time, and it levels up to Lv3 with more storage (70 / 105 / 140 slots) and better catches.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic Crab Catcher[/b] — recipe at Fishing level 6, two levels.[/*]
[*]Both use bait from their own storage and can restart cycles automatically. Every setting is in the config menu.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Farming[/b]
[list]
[*]50% chance to get a seed back when you harvest (configurable, on by default).[/*]
[*]Fertilizer gives a chance of double or triple harvests.[/*]
[*]Quality fertilizer and Speed-Gro can share one tile (any grade of each); the soil shows both effects blended.[/*]
[*]BSV Speed-Gro also speeds up regrowth.[/*]
[*]Four totems, taught by the Wizard: Growth, Harvest, Processing and Thunderstorm.[/*]
[*]Greenhouse expanded to 35 x 20 = 700 tiles, laid out so Quality, Iridium and pressure-nozzle Iridium sprinklers tile perfectly. Older saves upgrade automatically.[/*]
[*]Cellar floor doubled.[/*]
[*]Walk through tea bushes and trellis crops.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Orders[/b]
[list]
[*]An Order Terminal arrives by mail. Townsfolk place orders for your produce; finished orders pay into your income, and a summary shows how much your orders earned.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Horses[/b]
[list]
[*]Call your horse with [b]H[/b] from almost anywhere outdoors (J if another mod already uses H). Press again to send it away.[/*]
[*]30 coat colours, 20% faster riding, optional larger horses, owner-only riding in multiplayer.[/*]
[*]The horse's name shows when you point at it.[/*]
[/list]
[b]New items and food[/b]
[list]
[*]Tea: learn from Caroline, buy tea saplings from Pierre, make A Cup of Green Tea and Tea Cakes.[/*]
[*]Golden Apple: survive one lethal blow (once per day).[/*]
[*]BSV Keg (Farming 8): brews alcohol 25% faster and is the only way to make Farmhouse Special Grape Wine — and, rarely, the Ruby Reserve.[/*]
[*]Giant Lobster (with Giant Lobster Bait and Lobster Dinner), Lobster King, Mutant Lobster King, King Crab and King Crab Rice Bowl, Spirit Fish and Spirit Fish Soup.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*]All professions: reach level 5 or 10 in a skill and you get every profession of that tier; no more choosing. The Skills page shows them all.[/*]
[*]Two extra backpack upgrades at Pierre's: 48 slots (50,000g) and 60 slots (100,000g), with a scroll bar in the inventory menus.[/*]
[*]Place BSV machines, totems and kegs from up to 3 tiles away.[/*]
[*]The five original legendary fish can be caught once per year.[/*]
[*]AFK fishing (toggle with F8).[/*]
[*]Clint sells coal for 100g.[/*]
[*]13 languages: English, Chinese, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Vietnamese.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Checked with Automate, Chests Anywhere, CJB Cheats Menu, CJB Item Spawner, Content Patcher, Farm Type Manager, Generic Mod Config Menu, SpaceCore, Stardew Valley Expanded, Tractor Mod and UI Info Suite 2.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Install / Upgrade[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Quit the game and back up your saves.[/*]
[*]Delete the old Mods/BetterStardewValley folder, then copy in the new one. Your old config.json, fishing-machine.json and crab-catcher.json can be kept.[/*]
[*]Saves from 1.0.3 continue: machines keep their level, progress and running cycle; items keep their IDs.[/*]
[/list]In multiplayer, every player needs the same BSV version. Removing BSV in the middle of a save is not recommended.

[size=4][b]Changelog — 2.0.13 beta[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]New: Order Terminal, four totems, new seafood and recipes, Spirit Fish, BSV Keg, all professions, backpack upgrades to 60 slots.[/*]
[*]Greenhouse 700 tiles (auto-upgrade for older saves), cellar doubled.[/*]
[*]Fishing Machine: storage raised to 70 / 105 / 140 slots; catches follow the local water and time of day.[/*]
[*]Horses: call / send-away counter, 30 coats, coat colours stay aligned in every animation, name shows on hover.[/*]
[*]Fertilizer and Speed-Gro on one tile, seed refund on by default.[/*]
[*]Compatibility: Tractor Mod fertilizer/seed attachments, CJB Item Spawner scrolling, BSV data applied after other mods.[/*]
[*]Upgrade bridge from 1.0.3 (machines, config, greenhouse, cellar, items).[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Better Stardew Valley（BSV）2.0 —— 测试版[/b][/size]

BSV 为星露谷物语加入便利功能、自动化和新内容，风格和数值尽量贴近原版。2.0 相比 1.0.3 是一次大更新。目前是[b]测试版[/b]：请先备份存档，遇到问题请附上 SMAPI 日志反馈。

[size=4][b]需要[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]星露谷物语 1.6.15[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2 或更新版本[/*]
[*]可选：Generic Mod Config Menu（游戏内设置菜单）[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]功能[/b][/size]

[b]水边机器[/b]
[list]
[*][b]自动钓鱼机[/b]：钓鱼 5 级解锁配方。放在岸边（室外或矿洞）。只钓这片水域在当前时间能钓到的鱼，可升到 3 级，存储更大（70 / 105 / 140 格），收获更好。[/*]
[*][b]自动捕蟹机[/b]：钓鱼 6 级解锁配方，共两级。[/*]
[*]两种机器都用自己存储里的鱼饵，可以自动开始下一轮。所有数值都能在设置菜单里调。[/*]
[/list]
[b]种田[/b]
[list]
[*]收获时 50% 概率返还种子（可调，默认开启）。[/*]
[*]施肥后有机会双倍或三倍收获。[/*]
[*]品质肥料和生长激素可以施在同一块地上（各等级随意搭配），耕地上两种效果的点点会融合显示。[/*]
[*]BSV 生长激素还能加快作物再生。[/*]
[*]四种图腾，由法师传授：生长、丰收、加工、雷雨。[/*]
[*]温室扩到 35×20 = 700 格，优质、铱金、铱金+加压喷头洒水器都能整齐铺满。老存档自动升级。[/*]
[*]地窖地板扩大一倍。[/*]
[*]可以直接穿过茶树和棚架作物。[/*]
[/list]
[b]订单[/b]
[list]
[*]订单电脑会通过邮件寄给你。镇上的居民向你订购农产品，完成后收入入账，还能看到订单一共赚了多少钱。[/*]
[/list]
[b]马匹[/b]
[list]
[*]在室外几乎任何地方按 [b]H[/b] 呼唤马匹（如果别的 mod 已经占用 H，则用 J）。再按一次让马离开。[/*]
[*]30 种毛色，骑行速度 +20%，可选更大的马，联机时只有主人能骑。[/*]
[*]鼠标指着马时显示名字。[/*]
[/list]
[b]新物品和料理[/b]
[list]
[*]茶：从卡洛琳那里学会，向皮埃尔买茶苗，制作一杯绿茶和茶饼。[/*]
[*]金苹果：抵挡一次致命伤害（每天一次）。[/*]
[*]BSV 酒桶（耕种 8 级）：酿酒快 25%，只有它能酿出农家特酿葡萄酒，还有小概率酿出红宝石珍藏。[/*]
[*]大龙虾（附大龙虾鱼饵和龙虾大餐）、龙虾王、变异龙虾王、帝王蟹和帝王蟹盖浇饭、灵鱼和灵鱼汤。[/*]
[/list]
[b]其他[/b]
[list]
[*]全职业：技能到 5 级或 10 级时直接获得这一阶段的全部职业，不用再二选一。技能页会全部显示。[/*]
[*]皮埃尔店里可以再升级两次背包：48 格（50,000g）和 60 格（100,000g），背包界面会出现滚动条。[/*]
[*]BSV 机器、图腾和酒桶可以在 3 格范围内摆放。[/*]
[*]原版五种传说之鱼每年可以各钓一次。[/*]
[*]挂机钓鱼（F8 开关）。[/*]
[*]克林特的煤炭降到 100g。[/*]
[*]支持 13 种语言：英语、中文、德语、西班牙语、法语、匈牙利语、意大利语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语、俄语、土耳其语、越南语。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]兼容性[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]已对照检查：Automate、Chests Anywhere、CJB Cheats Menu、CJB Item Spawner、Content Patcher、Farm Type Manager、Generic Mod Config Menu、SpaceCore、Stardew Valley Expanded、Tractor Mod、UI Info Suite 2。[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]安装 / 升级[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]退出游戏，备份存档。[/*]
[*]删掉旧的 Mods/BetterStardewValley 文件夹，再放入新的。旧的 config.json、fishing-machine.json、crab-catcher.json 可以保留。[/*]
[*]1.0.3 的存档可以继续玩：机器保留等级、进度和正在进行的那一轮，物品编号不变。[/*]
[/list]联机时所有玩家要装同一版本的 BSV。不建议在存档中途卸载 BSV。

[size=4][b]更新日志 —— 2.0.13 测试版[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]新增：订单电脑、四种图腾、新海鲜和料理、灵鱼、BSV 酒桶、全职业、背包升级到 60 格。[/*]
[*]温室 700 格（老存档自动升级）双倍地窖。[/*]
[*]钓鱼机：存储提高到 70 / 105 / 140 格；渔获跟随当地水域和时间。[/*]
[*]马匹：呼唤 / 离开计数器，30 种毛色，所有动画中花纹都对齐，鼠标指着时显示名字。[/*]
[*]肥料和生长激素同一块地，返还种子默认开启。[/*]
[*]兼容性：Tractor Mod 的施肥/播种附件、CJB 物品生成器的滚动、BSV 数据在其他 mod 之后生效。[/*]
[*]从 1.0.3 升级的桥接（机器、设置、温室、地窖、物品）。[/*]
[/list]
